entries.title: Psalms 110:1
segments: ¶<<Psalm of David.>> Jehovah said unto my Lord, Sit at my right hand, until I put thine enemies [as] footstool of thy feet.

entries.title: Psalms 110:2
segments: Jehovah shall send the sceptre of thy might out of Zion: rule in the midst of thine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 110:3
segments: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in holy splendour: from the womb of the morning [shall come] to thee the dew of thy youth.

entries.title: Psalms 110:4
segments: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art priest for ever after the order of Melchisedek.

entries.title: Psalms 110:5
segments: ¶The Lord at thy right hand will smite through kings in the day of his anger.

entries.title: Psalms 110:6
segments: He shall judge among the nations; he shall fill [all places] with dead bodies; he shall smite through the head over a great country.

entries.title: Psalms 110:7
segments: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore shall he lift up the head.
